purpose: Background previews for three existing stages; not yet integrated into gameplay.
prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished 2D gameplay background for Houkimajo stage 1 'Night Forest', landscape 16:9. Environment only, no words, UI, characters, enemies, bullets or frames. Orthographic overhead view looking straight down onto a broad enchanted forest clearing at midnight, for a free-moving single-screen bullet-hell arena, not a side-scrolling landscape. Hand-painted anime fantasy game art with clean simplified rounded forms, soft cel-shaded surfaces, storybook charm matching a cute purple witch on a broom. Deep muted indigo and teal palette, restrained lavender moonlight. Wide spacious dark blue mossy earth filling central 70 percent, subtle low-frequency texture, faint sweeping mist. Cluster ancient twisted roots, fern silhouettes, small blue mushrooms and broken mossy stones near outer edges only; the forest should feel magical and invitingly mysterious. Small dim enchanted glows only around perimeter, no bright particles through playing field. Keep playable area flat/open, no solid objects in center, no big magic circle. Lower left 25 percent and top HUD strip particularly subdued. Beautiful perimeter detail but gentle and readable overall; bright projectiles will be drawn on top later. Full bleed opaque image, no transparency, no mockup, no lettering.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished 2D gameplay background for Houkimajo stage 2 'Pumpkin Marsh', landscape 16:9. Environment only, no words, UI, characters, enemies, bullets or frames. Orthographic overhead view straight down onto a spacious shallow enchanted swamp clearing at night, for a free-moving single-screen bullet-hell arena, no horizon, not a side-scrolling scene. Hand-painted anime fantasy game art, clean simplified rounded forms, soft cel shading, whimsical mildly spooky storybook charm matching a cute purple witch. Deep muted plum, moss green and blue-black shallow water palette, soft restrained amber accents. Central 70 percent is broad calm dark water over smooth muddy ground, only subtle ripples and low-frequency reflection, clean continuous navigable space. Around outer margins: clusters of rounded pumpkins, a few softly glowing carved pumpkins, curling vines, reeds, gnarled roots, mossy hummocks; contain the amber lights at edges. No enemies disguised as decor, no faces except small carved pumpkin lanterns at perimeter. Lower left 25 percent and top HUD strip subdued with no bright landmarks. No bridge or platforms across center, no bright flecks or distracting textures in playing field. Full bleed opaque environment, no transparency, no mockup, no lettering.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished 2D gameplay background for Houkimajo stage 3 'Witch Tower', landscape 16:9. Environment only, no words, readable glyphs, UI, characters, enemies, bullets or frames. Orthographic overhead view straight down into a broad circular arcane tower chamber, for a free-moving single-screen bullet-hell arena. Hand-painted anime fantasy game art, simplified clean forms and soft cel shading, storybook gothic charm matching a cute purple witch. Deep desaturated violet and indigo stone, aged muted gold trim, soft low-intensity amethyst light. Central 70 percent forms a very spacious dark flat slate arena, broad paving slabs with barely visible seams and faint worn concentric floor inlays, avoid a bright central magic seal. Edge set dressing only: curved stone wall fragments, small arcane bookshelves, telescope silhouette, a few softly lit crystals and candles, hints of a starry void beyond outer balustrade. Grand final-stage atmosphere but dark calm combat floor; no prop intrudes into center, no strong white highlights. Lower left 25 percent and top HUD strip particularly quiet to support overlays. No dramatic perspective or horizon, no glowing floor lines imitating hazards. Full bleed opaque environment, no transparency, no mockup, no lettering.
